blast_radius: A stalled reviewer loop halts the loopqueue pipeline; no data is destroyed.

throughput.derivation: loops.daily_counts()/window_count() over the loopqueue ledger (gitignored; read directly since plain rg skips it without -uu). Only covered days are sampled; absent days are never zero-padded.

verification.note: Graded on throughput, not liveness: a running loop with zero volume is DEGRADED.

what_it_does: OmniAgentOS reviewer loop; volume is ledger events carrying role=reviewer.
why_it_matters: Reviewer volume gates every candidate; a silent reviewer loop stalls landing without any process ever exiting non-zero.
